comment: Region definitions for the offline download catalogue (Phase 3). bbox is [west, south, east, north]. Keep ids URL-safe and stable — they become part of artifact filenames, which are also TileSourceRegistry keys (C3). osmExtract is the Geofabrik source covering the region; build-peaks.sh and build-places.sh derive their inputs from the union of these, so publishing a region automatically gets it summits and search rather than silently shipping a map with neither.
